page.notes: The "XII." at the lower right stands on the same line as "nus." and is set at the right margin; it is recorded as a catchword. Some letters are damaged: "Charactere" (VI) and "Miræus" (XI, the scan is faint, so the æ is uncertain). The "Index" heading is in small capitals. The v of "qvi", "qvo" and "simulqve" is printed as v but is a vowel, so it is transcribed as u.
